Keeps Gouge background power allowed by blocking changes on its own system power-setting page. Reads only system Settings and Vivo power-management content. Also checks Play Store foreground identity, without reading its content, to show the block screen if browser monitoring disconnects. Other apps\' power settings remain available. Administrator provisioning maintains this guard when its switch is turned off.
Start Focus lock immediately using your last session settings, or 30 minutes with default apps for your first session
Restricted by Gouge. Open Gouge > Why apps are locked, or tap its notification, for the active rules and recovery steps.

Gouge is enforcing a restriction configured on this phone.

Open Gouge > Why apps are locked, or tap the Gouge notification, to see the active rules, waiting periods and recovery steps.

An app can have several active locks. A temporary app unlock does not override curfew, cooldowns, required accessibility or VPN protection, or website rules.

Android may describe these Gouge restrictions as work policy even on a personal phone.
App or setting blocked? Tap to see the reasons.
Android may label Gouge restrictions as work policy. This page shows the active app locks and recovery steps.
Gouge browser and Google keyword filter

Adds a two-minute countdown when Play Store opens, observing only the foreground app identity for this feature. Checks browser address bars against your ordered domain rules and manga/comics category watchdog. Reads visible browser webpages and Google app content to detect your blocked words. Watches scrolling on recognized YouTube Shorts, Instagram and Reddit feeds in apps and supported browsers. When the Reddit allowlist is enabled, checks native community headers in Reddit and registered clients and covers unapproved or unverified screens. Warnings can lead to a 30-minute browsing, social-app and installation cooldown. Per-word and generic exceptions apply to keyword filtering. A blocked keyword match in Google opens a new-search screen; in browsers, tries to close the tab, otherwise returns Home. Processing stays on this device; inspected content is not stored or sent anywhere.
